name: lemon_squeezy-mcp
description: Lemon Squeezy (marketplaces): me, list_products, get_product, list_sales, get_sales_stats, refund. E

platform_mcp_lemon_squeezy_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LEMON_SQUEEZY_API_KEY
platform_mcp_lemon_squeezy_api_key.description: Lemon Squeezy API key (Settings > API > create key; 'Generated API keys are valid for a year'), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer {api_key}'. Test-mode keys only see test-mode data (https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/api/getting-started/requests).

platform_mcp_lemon_squeezy_store_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LEMON_SQUEEZY_STORE_ID
platform_mcp_lemon_squeezy_store_id.description: Numeric store id (GET /v1/stores). Filters list_products / list_sales with filter[store_id] and is required by get_sales_stats.

platform_mcp_lemon_squeezy_env.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LEMON_SQUEEZY_ENV
platform_mcp_lemon_squeezy_env.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = production host with test accounts or test keys. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

platform_mcp_lemon_squeezy_base_url.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LEMON_SQUEEZY_BASE_URL
platform_mcp_lemon_squeezy_base_url.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v1/users/me returns the key's user {data: {type: users, id, attributes: {name, email, color, avatar_url, ...}}}.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /v1/products?page[number]&page[size] (max 100) [&filter[store_id]=config store_id]. `price` is an INTEGER in cents of the store currency (999 = 9.99; price_formatted in raw); status is draft or published; `status` input is not a documented filter and is not sent; currency is not on the product (see the store).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /v1/products/:id; `price` is an integer in cents (see list_products).

tools.name: list_sales
tools.description: GET /v1/orders (newest first) [&filter[store_id]]. `amount` is total as an INTEGER in cents of `currency` (total_usd, refunded_amount and *_formatted in raw); status is pending, failed, paid, refunded, partial_refund or fraudulent. `product_id` and `since` are not sent (not documented order filters) - filter the rows by created_at / product_id yourself.

tools.name: get_sales_stats
tools.description: Store totals from GET /v1/stores/{config store_id}: revenue = total_revenue ('A positive integer in cents representing the total all-time revenue of the store in USD'), sales = total_sales (all-time count), plus thirty_day_revenue / thirty_day_sales. The API has no date-range report, so since / until / product_id are ignored and period is 'all_time'; refunds are not reported.

tools.name: refund
tools.description: MOVES MONEY - DESTRUCTIVE: POST /v1/orders/:id/refund issues a FULL refund when `amount` is omitted, otherwise a partial refund of `amount` as an INTEGER in cents of the order currency (100 = 1.00; a non-integer amount is rejected before sending). `reason` is not accepted. Returns the order with updated refunded / refunded_amount.
